text:
alex: Hey team — first week here! I followed the onboarding doc but I can’t open the Feature Flags panel in staging (403). Console shows me as "viewer" only. Who should I ping to get temporary admin or FF access for testing?

maria: Welcome! :wave: Do you get the SSO prompt? sometimes the staging roles take a bit to sync after the account is provisioned.

alex: I signed in via Okta and landed in the right org. Other new hires in my cohort have FF access already.

maria: OK. @ops-rep can you check group memberships for alex? Looks like they might be missing the redwood-staging-devs group which grants ff:edit.

ops-rep: infra ticket queued — #INC-4321. I can grant temporary console-admin for 2h if you need immediate work. Want that?

alex: That’d be super helpful. I need to run an eval against a new prompt set and toggle flags while watching rollout.

ops-rep: Done, granted console-admin on staging for 2 hours. You should be able to toggle flags now. If you still see 403, try a hard refresh or log out and back in.

alex: I see the flags now, thanks! Quick question—do we use a service account for automated eval runs? I don’t want to use my user token for CI.

sam: Yep, we have a service account pattern. See the internal doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/ci/service-accounts. Short version: create an SA in the infra console, then request an API key via Secrets Manager and scope it to embeddings+inference.

alex: Any cli command to request the key?

sam: Use the helper: `rwctl sa create --name alex-evals --env staging` then `rwctl sa key create --sa alex-evals --roles inference,embeddings`. Ops will need to approve the first key rotation.

alex: Perfect, thanks. One more: is there a sandbox org for feature flag experiments where we can safely kill traffic? Don’t want to break staging rollouts.

tara: We have a sandbox org called `ff-sandbox` under the staging directory. It's intended for dev/test toggles. Not production safe, but safe to use for experiments. Ping me if you want me to copy over a subset of flags.

alex: Awesome — can you copy the current eval flags to ff-sandbox? I’ll run the set this afternoon.

tara: On it. Will mirror `eval-*` flags and add a note on who owns them.

infra-bot: #INC-4321 status update: membership change applied to alex; console-admin role bound for 2 hours.

alex: Everything’s working now. Thanks all! :raised_hands:

maria: Welcome aboard again. If you want, I can do a quick walkthrough of the rollout dashboard at 3pm.

alex: Yes please — 3pm works.

ops-rep: Closing the short-term access in 2 hours automatically. If you need longer, reply here and we’ll convert to a longer sandbox role.

alex: Will do. Thanks everyone :)
